rationale: The CSR counter is a single-clock synchronous block, and increment, write, load data, and both counter outputs have complete clock-relative delays.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the counter to a 64-bit register with low/high writes, increment, and next-value output.

mutation.description: The implementation always exposes the incremented next value; it does not create another clock or timing relationship.
